theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [Field K] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module K M] [Finite ι] [Infinite K] (f : ι → Module.Dual K M) (h : ∀ (i : ι), ∃ x, (f i) x ≠ 0) : ∃ x, ∀ (i : ι), (f i) x ≠ 0 := by
  let f' : ι → M → K := f
  let k : Set ι := Set.univ
  let hli : LinearIndepOn K (λ i : ι, 1) k := by
    intro i j hne
    cases hne with i j
    contradiction
  let ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.exists_dual_forall_apply_eq_one K M (λ i : ι, 1) hli
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hg
  exact x
